sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Civil Sectt. Lko And 3 Oth
Counsel for Applicant :- Kaushal Kishore Tewari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
Despite service of notice, no one appeared on behalf of the complainant.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.62 of 2024, under Sections 376(3), 452, 504,
506 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Baghrai, District Pratapgarh.

3. An FIR was lodged on 04.03.2024 alleging that on 26.02.2024, the daughter of the informant aged about 15 years was alone at the home when the applicant came inside the house and committed wrong on her.
In the statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C., the victim reiterated the same version.

sentences.text: She also stated that she had inform her mother about the incident on 01.03.2024 when she came together to home.
After lodging of the FIR, the medical of the victim was done on 04.03.2024 wherein no fresh injuries were shown on the internal part of the victim.
The tentative age of the victim as per the medical examination is around 17 years.
In the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., the victim stated that the applicant was the son of the sister of the victim.
She also stated that her mother was unwell and was taken to the doctor on the date of the alleged incident.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the two statements under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C., there is a substantial variance, inasmuch as, in one statement, she stated that the mother of the victim had gone outside the home and returned on 01.03.2024 whereas in the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P,C., she stated that her mother was taken to the doctor with the victim and also considering the substantial delay in lodging of the FIR coupled with he fact that no material on record to corroborate the alleatgions and also the fact that the tentative age of the victim is around 17 years coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 07.03.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Kuldeep Saroj be released on bail in the aforesaid first information report on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
